title: Words of Holy Monks
english: It is necessary to inquire about the ways of the monks who have progressed rightly and to be set straight by them, for many things may be found said and done well by them. Among these, one of them says that the drier and not irregular diet, yoked with love, quickly brings the monk into the harbor of dispassion.

And the same elder delivered a brother troubled at night by phantasms, commanding him to serve the sick with fasting; for in no other way, he said when asked, are such passions quenched than by mercy.

One of the wise of that time approached the righteous Antony and said: How do you endure, O father, deprived of the consolation of books? And he says: My book, philosopher, is the nature of created things, and it is possible whenever I wish to read the logoi of God.

The Egyptian elder Macarius, a vessel of election, asked me: Why is it that, bearing grudges against men, we destroy the memory-power of the soul, but bearing grudges against demons, we remain unharmed? And when I was perplexed at the answer and begged to learn the reason, he said: Because the former is contrary to nature, but the latter is according to the nature of thumos.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
